caption: The drawing depicts a single object with two distinct sections resting on a plain, off-white background. On the left side, there is a cone-shaped piece with a wood-like texture and brown coloration, resembling the wide end of a horn or funnel. This cone-shaped section tapers and connects to a cylindrical segment, followed by a long, narrow, and slightly bent rod that turns in a gentle “S” shape. At the rightmost end, the rod terminates in a flat, rectangular paddle that is colored a darker brown, similar to oxidized metal. Near the object’s right side and below it, the name "George Brown" appears written in small, uppercase, reddish-brown letters. No other objects or distinguishable features are present in the image.
title: Horse Shoer's Knife
